svg.text: 19 Oct 2024 — alleged encounter at Chi Phi (civil suit)
Weeks later — report to Cornell police; no charges then
Sep 2026 — civil lawsuit; DA says he will reopen
1 Oct 2026 — Hochul names AG James special prosecutor
2 Oct 2026 — Hochul press remarks on police and DA steps
Allegation is unadjudicated. No criminal conviction is reported.
